findings.summary: Two from_entry hunks add .with_depth(depth) where the next line already wraps in WithDepth, so errors now nest WithDepth twice; changes the public enum's structure with no change to depth()
Windows metadata_internal and is_same_file_system were not given depth while the Unix twin was, leaving platform divergence
DirEntryInner::metadata hand-rolls Error::from_walkdir; use it instead
No test and body does not say which case it fixes
Commit subject does not match repo convention

why: Noise set: the one blocking finding is the confirmed redundant double WithDepth nesting, which alters a public enum's structure; the Windows-twin gap is incomplete coverage a maintainer would merge past, so it is a nit.
